news.title: CSE projects tackle lake health, wild rice restoration through sustainability grants
news.summary_en: The Institute on the Environment (IonE) is supporting 10 outcomes-driven projects across the University of Minnesota system through its $1.5 million Impact Goals grantmaking program. Among them are two College of Science and Engineering-led initiatives.

news.title: Computer Science Assistant Professor Stevie Chancellor named Novus Faculty Impact Fellow
news.summary_en: University of Minnesota Department of Computer Science & Engineering Assistant Professor Stevie Chancellor has been named a recipient of the Novus Faculty Impact Fellowship for her groundbreaking work in human-centered AI to improve mental health outcomes online.

news.title: Graduate student aims to advance hypersonic turbulence knowledge
news.summary_en: Ph.D. student Carter Vu is studying that split second transition from laminar to turbulent flow — and he’s doing it with an interdisciplinary research group of STEM experts across the University of Minnesota.

news.title: Students and alumni entrepreneurs among 2026 MN Cup semifinalists
news.summary_en: From breast cancer detection technology to herbal supplements, six companies with College of Science and Engineering ties made it to the semifinal rounds.
